rationale.because: the person chose a modern two-tone outline; the line carries the icon, the fill adds volume

rationale.decision: stroke 2, round caps and joins, grid 24 / live 20
rationale.because: Lucide (42 imports, default stroke 2) stays for generic icons; the new set sits next to it
--radius is 0.5rem (8 px) → 0.2× ≈ 1.6–2 on a 24 grid; Roboto (neo-grotesque) asks for slightly tighter corners

rationale.decision: light: default slate-500, hover gray-900, active blue-700, disabled slate-300
rationale.because: white sidebar: muted text #6B7280-ish, active item text blue-700 on blue-50

rationale.decision: dark: default slate-400, hover slate-50, active white
rationale.because: navy sidebar #0B1120; active item is filled blue-600 with white text, so the icon goes white

rationale.decision: soft fill 14–25% of the line color
rationale.because: keeps the fill readable as a tint on both #FFFFFF and #0B1120 without competing with the line
the sidebar switches theme with data-theme on <aside>, not the global .dark class
the active menu link gets aria-current so the active tones apply (and screen readers announce it)
